cases.setup: A pinned Python analyzer checks a name-based attribute receiver by spelling, has lexical scope bindings with full import identities, and publicly fails an aliased overload case while passing its canonical equivalent.
checks: Current recognition and import-binding owners are bound to code anchors.
Nearest-binding origin lookup can replace spelling classification without changing helper-name filtering.
The public alias gap is observed rather than inferred from historical evidence.

cases.setup: An annotation complaint lacks a pinned base, public reproduction, or located recognition owner.
checks: Only read or probe operations are authorized.

cases.setup: Current code already resolves the nearest receiver binding and accepts only supported module-import origins; the reported failure occurs elsewhere.
checks: No duplicate origin-resolution edit is proposed.

cases.setup: The target requires chained-attribute alias tracking or non-Python objects that cannot bind to the supported Python scope and import interfaces.
checks: Receiver-shape and language boundaries are respected.
No unsourced bridge or new historical realization is invented.
